name: SheetsData
description: Electronic component datasheets for AI agents: pinouts, specs, package info and design checks from manufacturer PDFs. Searches parts across JLCPCB, Mouser and DigiKey, finds parts by spec, checks a BOM, reads or searches any datasheet section, compares parts, suggests alternatives and checks operating conditions against a part's ratings. Hosted service; tool calls need a SheetsData account (OAuth). Paid per call with a free start: part search is free and sign-up includes $5 of credit.
author: Octoco Ltd
